articles.summary: LUBBOCK, Texas, Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- South Plains Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ:SPFI) (“South Plains” or the “Company”), the parent company of City Bank, today announced that its third quarter 2026 financial results will be released after the market closes on Thursday, October 22, 2026.
articles.title: South Plains Financial, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call
